name: Schedule campaign
description: Call this when a drafted email campaign should go out automatically at a specific future date and time rather than right away. Set the campaign's content and recipients first, and validate it, before scheduling. Use campaigns.send_now instead when the campaign should go out immediately with no delay; use campaigns.validate_campaign or campaigns.validate_campaign_content first if you are not yet sure the campaign is ready to send; use campaigns.get_campaign to read back the campaign's current status and scheduled time.
preconditions: The campaign identified by the path id must already exist.
The campaign must be in a state that still accepts scheduling (not already sent).
The caller must be authenticated to the Brevo account that owns the campaign.

id.description: Identifier of the campaign to schedule, taken from the request path (observed as "3").

schedule_date_time.description: Date and time at which the campaign should be sent, observed in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (e.g. "2026-11-07 04:30:00"). Must be in the future.

is_raw_schedule_date_time.description: Observed sent as true alongside a plain "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" value, indicating the timestamp is supplied as-is rather than as a timezone-normalized value. Exact semantics are not documented.

outputs.description: No response body. Success is signalled by HTTP 204 No Content.

side_effects: The campaign is moved into a scheduled/queued state for the given date and time.
Any previously set send time on the campaign is replaced.
At the scheduled time the campaign is sent to its recipients without further confirmation, which cannot be undone once delivery starts.
